title: Taskfold · progress
headline: The agreed P1 batch is complete. P2 and account-deletion follow-up remain.
latest: Local task-bound file custody now follows reviewed same-team moves and Undo, denies deleted-root file access, and renews generations only through certified deletion Undo. Each repo independently passes 59 database custody checks, 68 existing transfer regressions and 90 focused Core checks. Upload/admission, real provider delivery and native file-flow acceptance remain unfinished. No hosted deployment or normal-use gate changed; curated checkpoint totals are unchanged.
next: Accept Mac existing-history controls and wider phone/tablet new/retired identities, changed lifecycle, stale/account/access, privacy, keyboard/speech/largest-text/contrast/large-library cases. Verify other Files destinations; only observed local Documents is accepted.

Continue historical child-recipient and recurrence/lifecycle histories, then broader legacy/cache/editor migration. Root project/assignee history and preserved-child read-only previews now have scoped local Mac/iPhone/iPad proof; hosted delivery and wider accessibility/account/window cases remain separate.

Implement trusted upload/admission and native file publishing/recovery, then verify provider delivery, legacy-file migration, audio and genuine shared-account custody. The local task-bound move/deletion/Undo foundation now has independent database/Core proof; it is not end-to-end file acceptance.

Complete remaining Mac format-repair/hierarchy keyboard, inspector and cross-task-move acceptance, plus full largest-text recovery and wider account/window/privacy/speech/large-library checks. Preserve deletion-recovery gaps and all agreed deferrals.
